description.en: Leaves "stand event" dialogue mode started with StartStandEvent: restores the camera's depth-of-field, restores the previous pause bit state, and resets the talk-character registry. Does nothing (and logs a message) if no stand event is active.
Optional number of frames for the depth-of-field transition back (defaults to 10).
No explicit return statement (an early `return;` with no value when not active) — implicitly null.
